description: Incidents newest first by the date they were first on record, optionally within a date range. That date is a filing's date, or the day Have I Been Pwned added an entry to its catalog, and each incident's firstDateKind says which; it is not when the breach happened. Records are verified from regulator filings and Have I Been Pwned; a threat actor's claim is never a source. A miss means there is no record here, not that no breach happened. Counts from different sources are not additive.
name: recent_breaches
title: Breaches most recently on record
